# Communists
Communists are an organized hostile expedition faction that relies on squads and mutual support. Unlike scattered groups of pirates, Soviet troops usually fight in teams: leader + riflemen + medic.
# Regular Army Soldiers [bold][color=#a4885c]General characteristics:[/color][/bold] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Health:[/color][/bold] usually 100; medics have 80 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 3.5 m/s (basic rifleman templates) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Armor protection (Flak):[/color][/bold] [color=red]Blunt[/color] 15% [color=red]Slash[/color] 15% [color=yellow]Piercing[/color] 45% [color=orange]Heat[/color] 40% - [bold][color=#a4885c]Traits:[/color][/bold] light standard-issue armor, strength in numbers, quality ammunition, and throwable explosive grenades.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Roles:[/color][/bold] squad sergeants, riflemen, submachine gunners, machine gunners, and medics.
# Landing Troops [bold][color=#a4885c]General characteristics:[/color][/bold] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Health:[/color][/bold] usually 100; medics have 80 - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed:[/color][/bold] 3.5 m/s base, with marines sprinting up to 4.5 m/s - [bold][color=#a4885c]Armor protection:[/color][/bold] 15% / 50% (typically [color=red]Blunt[/color] and [color=red]Slash[/color] around 15%, [color=yellow]Piercing[/color] up to 50%) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Traits:[/color][/bold] jumping and rolling, heavier equipment, and reinforced breaching roles
# Squad Tactics Communist groups usually appear as ready-made units: - Infantry squads (leader + riflemen + medic) - Submachine gun squads, machine gun teams, and patrol groups - Light and heavy [bold][color=#FF3B3BFF]MECH[/color][/bold]anized units
In combat, this means steadier, sustained pressure and fewer "lone" targets.
# Commanders and Heavy Support [bold][color=#a4885c]General characteristics:[/color][/bold] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Captain:[/color][/bold] speed 4.5 m/s, serving as leader and firepower support - [bold][color=#a4885c]Light mech (Hammer):[/color][/bold] 300 HP, increased hull armor - [bold][color=#a4885c]Heavy mech:[/color][/bold] 400 HP, maximum durability and suppression - [bold][color=#a4885c]Combat bears:[/color][/bold] up to 300 HP, high melee damage
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Threat:[/color][/bold] THEY HAVE A COMBAT BEAR!!!
